thread:
anya (PM): Heads-up: HealthCo asked for contract-level priority queue + burst SLA for Dedicated. 6-week turnaround request. Do we productize or handle as bespoke SOW?

sam (Sales): Big deal: >$1M ARR. They want priority during nightly batch windows only. Prefer a clear add-on if possible.

leo (Finance): We'll need pricing for reserved headroom + consumption. Tokenized billing looks promising: baseline reserved + consumed priority tokens.

marta (Legal): Need precise definitions in SOW: what "priority" means, measurement windows, credit cap. Avoid open-ended monetary penalties.

devin (Eng): Tech work: add per-contract tokens, routing priority lane, and telemetry. Estimate 3w eng + 1w QA for prototype. Risk: impact on non-priority customers unless admission control in place.

nora (Solutions): HealthCo will run 2h nightly scoring windows. Time-windowed priority reduces cost. They can accept preemption outside windows.

anya (PM): Draft launch criteria: SLA metric spec (95/99 tails), token billing model, per-contract telemetry, legal clause template, eng prototype + canary.

sam (Sales): Suggest starting list price: token surcharge + per-10k token price, with multi-year discounts.

leo (Finance): I'll run margin models and propose a price band by Friday. Need expected burst frequency from Solutions.

devin (Eng): Prototype config example and routing flag ready to iterate. Canary one region, limited contracts.

marta (Legal): I'll draft the clause and exhibit limiting credits. ETA 5 business days.

anya (PM): Owners & IDS: devin -> prototype (3w), leo -> pricing (Fri), marta -> legal draft (+5bd), sam -> negotiate timeline, nora -> customer traffic CSV (+4d). Sync Mon 11am.

sam (Sales): I'll push for 12-month minimum commit. Need a placeholder list price for negotiations.

anya (PM): Preference: productized "priority add-on" unless customer requires exclusivity. Keeps scale. :thumbsup:
